summary: Brenmiller Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a $1,000,000 subsequent funding tranche with Alpha Capital Anstalt under an existing securities purchase agreement. The issuance consisted of 1,000 preferred shares convertible at $3.39 per share and five-year ordinary warrants for 68,681 shares at $14.56. Net proceeds fund working capital and commercial TES projects. This is a routine structured financing, not a special situation. No special-situation action (acquisition, divestiture, tender, etc.) is disclosed; the filing merely updates prior financing activities.
